SELECT -- education 테이블 edu.EDUCATION_NO AS EDUCATION_NO, edu.RESUME_NO AS EDUCATION_RESUME_NO, edu.HIGHEST_EDUCATION_CODE AS HIGHEST_EDUCATION_CODE, edu.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME, edu.GRADUATE_YN AS GRADUATE_YN, edu.TRANSFER_YN AS TRANSFER_YN, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(edu.ENTRANCE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ENTRANCE_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(edu.GRADUATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS GRADUATE_DATE, edu.LOCATION AS EDUCATION_LOCATION, edu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, edu.DELETE_DATE AS EDUCATION_DELETE_DATE,
-- specialty 테이블 spc.EDUCATION_NO AS SPECIALTY_EDUCATION_NO, spc.RESUME_NO AS SPECIALTY_RESUME_NO, spc.MAIN_MAJOR AS MAIN_MAJOR, spc.SUB_MAJOR AS SUB_MAJOR, spc.SUB_MAJOR_CODE AS SUB_MAJOR_CODE, spc.DELETE_DATE AS SPECIALTY_DELETE_DATE FROM education edu LEFT JOIN specialty spc ON edu.EDUCATION_NO = spc.EDUCATION_NO WHERE edu.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo} and edu.EDUCATION_NO = #{educationNo}
